participation.context: Looked, and did not write a line for anyone to say.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the poem still only a plan of two houses

story.body: You read the two houses back and added no speech. You did not open a king. The tables stayed as Saturday night left them.

relations.note: the poem still only a plan of two houses

title: Read the two houses in Brooke

participation.context: Wrote the note and left every unsent thing unsent.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the letter still without a day

story.body: You dated a short note, left the letter unsent, and did not turn Saturday's part into a horse. You named the Bull as tomorrow and did not hire it tonight.

relations.note: the letter still without a day

title: Wrote the day on a short note
